# National Park Service (NPS.gov)

> The official gateway to America's 423+ national parks, monuments, and historic sites, providing visitor planning, park discovery, and conservation information.

NPS.gov serves as the primary digital resource for the U.S. National Park Service, offering comprehensive information about parks across all 50 states and U.S. territories. The site emphasizes visitor access, historical preservation, environmental stewardship, and public engagement through programs like Every Kid Outdoors and the America the Beautiful Pass.

## Key Topics

- National Park Service
- National Parks
- State Parks Directory
- Historic Sites
- Historic Trails
- Visitor Information

- America the Beautiful Pass

- Cultural Heritage
- Park Planning
- Outdoor Recreation

## Core Park Discovery

- [NPS.gov Homepage](https://www.nps.gov/index.htm): Main NPS homepage featuring parks, programs, and visitor planning resources
- [Find a Park](https://www.nps.gov/findapark/index.htm): Park finder tool for searching national parks by state and location

## State Parks Directory

- [Alabama Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/al/index.htm): Alabama state parks directory including civil rights sites and historic locations
- [Alaska Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/ak/index.htm): Alaska state parks directory featuring Katmai and wilderness areas
- [American Samoa Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/as/index.htm): American Samoa parks directory including National Park of American Samoa
- [Arizona Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/az/index.htm): Arizona state parks directory with Canyon de Chelly and historic trails
- [Arkansas Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/ar/index.htm): Arkansas state parks directory featuring Buffalo National River
- [California Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/ca/index.htm): California state parks directory including Alcatraz Island and historic sites
- [Colorado Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/co/index.htm): Colorado state parks directory with national parks and historic sites
- [Connecticut Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/ct/index.htm): Connecticut state parks directory featuring Appalachian Trail
- [Delaware Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/de/index.htm): Delaware state parks directory with Chesapeake Bay historic trails
- [District of Columbia Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/dc/index.htm): Washington DC parks directory featuring monuments and civil rights sites
- [Florida Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/fl/index.htm): Florida state parks directory including Everglades and Big Cypress
- [Georgia Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/ga/index.htm): Georgia state parks directory featuring Andersonville historic sites
- [Guam Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/gu/index.htm): Guam parks directory with War in the Pacific National Historical Park
- [Hawaii Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/hi/index.htm): Hawaii state parks directory featuring Haleakalā and Hawaiian culture
- [Idaho Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/id/index.htm): Idaho state parks directory with historic trails and outdoor recreation
- [Illinois Parks](https://www.nps.gov/state/il/index.htm): Illinois state parks directory including civil rights and Lincoln sites

## Visitor Programs & Celebrations

- [Spring Season Celebrations](https://www.nps.gov/subjects/npscelebrates/spring-season.htm): Guide to spring celebrations including Women's History Month and National Park Week
